_comment: Verified genshin-db metadata. Existing recommendation fields are legacy editorial opinions, not datamined mechanics; absent opinions remain unavailable.

Aether.name: Aether
Aether.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

Aino.name: Aino
Aino.title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
Aino.description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

Albedo.name: Albedo
Albedo.title: Kreideprinz
Albedo.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

Alhaitham.name: Alhaitham
Alhaitham.title: Admonishing Instruction
Alhaitham.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

Aloy.name: Aloy
Aloy.title: Savior From Another World
Aloy.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

Alyosha.name: Alyosha
Alyosha.title: Swift-Striding Hound
Alyosha.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

Amber.name: Amber
Amber.title: Gliding Champion
Amber.description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

AratakiItto.name: Arataki Itto
AratakiItto.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
AratakiItto.description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

Arlecchino.name: Arlecchino
Arlecchino.title: Dire Balemoon
Arlecchino.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

Baizhu.name: Baizhu
Baizhu.title: Beyond Mortality
Baizhu.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

voiceActors.japanese: 遊佐浩二 & 庄子裕衣

Barbara.name: Barbara
Barbara.title: Shining Idol
Barbara.description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

Beidou.name: Beidou
Beidou.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
Beidou.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

Bennett.name: Bennett
Bennett.title: Trial by Fire
Bennett.description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

Candace.name: Candace
Candace.title: Golden Vow
Candace.description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

Charlotte.name: Charlotte
Charlotte.title: Lens of Verity
Charlotte.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

Chasca.name: Chasca
Chasca.title: Skyborne Arbiter
Chasca.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

Chevreuse.name: Chevreuse
Chevreuse.title: Executor of Justice
Chevreuse.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

Chiori.name: Chiori
Chiori.title: The Thundering Seamstress
Chiori.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

Chongyun.name: Chongyun
Chongyun.title: Frozen Ardor
Chongyun.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

Citlali.name: Citlali
Citlali.title: Obsidian Opalstar
Citlali.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

Clorinde.name: Clorinde
Clorinde.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
Clorinde.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

Collei.name: Collei
Collei.title: Sprout of Rebirth
Collei.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

Columbina.name: Columbina
Columbina.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
Columbina.description: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

Cyno.name: Cyno
Cyno.title: Judicator of Secrets
Cyno.description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

Dahlia.name: Dahlia
Dahlia.title: Ode and Oblation
Dahlia.description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

Dehya.name: Dehya
Dehya.title: Flame-Mane
Dehya.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

Diluc.name: Diluc
Diluc.title: Dark Side of Dawn
Diluc.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

Diona.name: Diona
Diona.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
Diona.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

Dori.name: Dori
Dori.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
Dori.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

Durin.name: Durin
Durin.title: "The Undying Fire"
Durin.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

Emilie.name: Emilie
Emilie.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
Emilie.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

Escoffier.name: Escoffier
Escoffier.title: Tasteful Excellence
Escoffier.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

Eula.name: Eula
Eula.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
Eula.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

Faruzan.name: Faruzan
Faruzan.title: Enigmatic Machinist
Faruzan.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

Fischl.name: Fischl
Fischl.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
Fischl.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

voiceActors.japanese: 内田真礼 & 増谷康紀

Flins.name: Flins
Flins.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
Flins.description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

Freminet.name: Freminet
Freminet.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
Freminet.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

Furina.name: Furina
Furina.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
Furina.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

Gaming.name: Gaming
Gaming.title: Leonine Vanguard
Gaming.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.
Gaming.affiliation: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency

Ganyu.name: Ganyu
Ganyu.title: Plenilune Gaze
Ganyu.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

Gorou.name: Gorou
Gorou.title: Canine Warrior
Gorou.description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

HuTao.name: Hu Tao
HuTao.title: Fragrance in Thaw
HuTao.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

Iansan.name: Iansan
Iansan.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
Iansan.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

Ifa.name: Ifa
Ifa.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
Ifa.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

Illuga.name: Illuga
Illuga.title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
Illuga.description: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

Ineffa.name: Ineffa
Ineffa.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
Ineffa.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

Jahoda.name: Jahoda
Jahoda.title: Windthreading Shadow
Jahoda.description: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

Jean.name: Jean
Jean.title: Dandelion Knight
Jean.description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

Kachina.name: Kachina
Kachina.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
Kachina.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

KaedeharaKazuha.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
KaedeharaKazuha.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
KaedeharaKazuha.description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

Kaeya.name: Kaeya
Kaeya.title: Frostwind Swordsman
Kaeya.description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

KamisatoAyaka.name: Kamisato Ayaka
KamisatoAyaka.title: Frostflake Heron
KamisatoAyaka.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

KamisatoAyato.name: Kamisato Ayato
KamisatoAyato.title: Pillar of Fortitude
KamisatoAyato.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

Kaveh.name: Kaveh
Kaveh.title: Empyrean Reflection
Kaveh.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

Keqing.name: Keqing
Keqing.title: Driving Thunder
Keqing.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

Kinich.name: Kinich
Kinich.title: Turnfire Hunt
Kinich.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

voiceActors.japanese: 杉山紀彰 & 竹内順子

Kirara.name: Kirara
Kirara.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
Kirara.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

Klee.name: Klee
Klee.title: Fleeing Sunlight
Klee.description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

KujouSara.name: Kujou Sara
KujouSara.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
KujouSara.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

KukiShinobu.name: Kuki Shinobu
KukiShinobu.title: Mender of Tribulations
KukiShinobu.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

LanYan.name: Lan Yan
LanYan.title: Spring Woven From Jade
LanYan.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

Lauma.name: Lauma
Lauma.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
Lauma.description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

Layla.name: Layla
Layla.title: Fantastical Evening Star
Layla.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

Linnea.name: Linnea
Linnea.title: Augur of Wonders
Linnea.description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

Lisa.name: Lisa
Lisa.title: Witch of Purple Rose
Lisa.description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

Lohen.name: Lohen
Lohen.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
Lohen.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

Lumine.name: Lumine
Lumine.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

Lynette.name: Lynette
Lynette.title: Elegance in the Shadows
Lynette.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

Lyney.name: Lyney
Lyney.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
Lyney.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

Manekin.name: Manekin
Manekin.description: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

Manekina.name: Manekina
Manekina.description: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

Mavuika.name: Mavuika
Mavuika.title: Night-Igniting Flame
Mavuika.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

Mika.name: Mika
Mika.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
Mika.description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

Mona.name: Mona
Mona.title: Astral Reflection
Mona.description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

Mualani.name: Mualani
Mualani.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
Mualani.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

Nahida.name: Nahida
Nahida.title: Physic of Purity
Nahida.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

Navia.name: Navia
Navia.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
Navia.description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

Nefer.name: Nefer
Nefer.title: Secret Beneath the Sands
Nefer.description: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

Neuvillette.name: Neuvillette
Neuvillette.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
Neuvillette.description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

Nilou.name: Nilou
Nilou.title: Dance of Lotuslight
Nilou.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

Ningguang.name: Ningguang
Ningguang.title: Eclipsing Star
Ningguang.description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

Noelle.name: Noelle
Noelle.title: Chivalric Blossom
Noelle.description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

Odette.name: Odette
Odette.title: Swirling Snow
Odette.description: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

Ororon.name: Ororon
Ororon.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
Ororon.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

Prune.name: Prune
Prune.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
Prune.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

Qiqi.name: Qiqi
Qiqi.title: Icy Resurrection
Qiqi.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

RaidenShogun.name: Raiden Shogun
RaidenShogun.title: Plane of Euthymia
RaidenShogun.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

Razor.name: Razor
Razor.title: Wolf Boy
Razor.description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

Rosaria.name: Rosaria
Rosaria.title: Thorny Benevolence
Rosaria.description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

Sandrone.name: Sandrone
Sandrone.title: Mirrored Analysis
Sandrone.description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

SangonomiyaKokomi.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
SangonomiyaKokomi.title: Pearl of Wisdom
SangonomiyaKokomi.description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

Sayu.name: Sayu
Sayu.title: Mujina Ninja
Sayu.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

Sethos.name: Sethos
Sethos.title: Wisdom's Measure
Sethos.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

Shenhe.name: Shenhe
Shenhe.title: Lonesome Transcendence
Shenhe.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

ShikanoinHeizou.name: Shikanoin Heizou
ShikanoinHeizou.title: Analytical Harmony
ShikanoinHeizou.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

Sigewinne.name: Sigewinne
Sigewinne.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
Sigewinne.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

Skirk.name: Skirk
Skirk.title: Void Star
Skirk.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

Sucrose.name: Sucrose
Sucrose.title: Harmless Sweetie
Sucrose.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

Tartaglia.name: Tartaglia
Tartaglia.title: Childe
Tartaglia.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

Thoma.name: Thoma
Thoma.title: Protector From Afar
Thoma.description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

Tighnari.name: Tighnari
Tighnari.title: Verdant Strider
Tighnari.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

Varesa.name: Varesa
Varesa.title: Strength in Serenity
Varesa.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

Varka.name: Varka
Varka.title: Knight of Boreas
Varka.description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

Venti.name: Venti
Venti.title: Windborne Bard
Venti.description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

Vesna.name: Vesna
Vesna.title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
Vesna.description: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.

Vodyanitsa.name: Vodyanitsa
Vodyanitsa.title: Lingering Siren-Song
Vodyanitsa.description: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin.

Wanderer.name: Wanderer
Wanderer.title: Eons Adrift
Wanderer.description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

Wriothesley.name: Wriothesley
Wriothesley.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
Wriothesley.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

Xiangling.name: Xiangling
Xiangling.title: Exquisite Delicacy
Xiangling.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

Xianyun.name: Xianyun
Xianyun.title: Passerine Herald
Xianyun.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

Xiao.name: Xiao
Xiao.title: Vigilant Yaksha
Xiao.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

Xilonen.name: Xilonen
Xilonen.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
Xilonen.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

Xingqiu.name: Xingqiu
Xingqiu.title: Juvenile Galant
Xingqiu.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

Xinyan.name: Xinyan
Xinyan.title: Blazing Riff
Xinyan.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

YaeMiko.name: Yae Miko
YaeMiko.title: Astute Amusement
YaeMiko.description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

Yanfei.name: Yanfei
Yanfei.title: Wise Innocence
Yanfei.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

Yaoyao.name: Yaoyao
Yaoyao.title: Burgeoning Grace
Yaoyao.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

Yelan.name: Yelan
Yelan.title: Valley Orchid
Yelan.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

Yoimiya.name: Yoimiya
Yoimiya.title: Frolicking Flames
Yoimiya.description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

YumemizukiMizuki.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
YumemizukiMizuki.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
YumemizukiMizuki.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

YunJin.name: Yun Jin
YunJin.title: Stage Lucida
YunJin.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

voiceActors.japanese: 小岩井ことり & Yang Yang

Zhongli.name: Zhongli
Zhongli.title: Vago Mundo
Zhongli.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

Zibai.name: Zibai
Zibai.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
Zibai.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

TravelerAnemo.name: Traveler (Anemo)
TravelerAnemo.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerCryo.name: Traveler (Cryo)
TravelerCryo.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerDendro.name: Traveler (Dendro)
TravelerDendro.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerElectro.name: Traveler (Electro)
TravelerElectro.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerGeo.name: Traveler (Geo)
TravelerGeo.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerHydro.name: Traveler (Hydro)
TravelerHydro.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

TravelerPyro.name: Traveler (Pyro)
TravelerPyro.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.
